relationships.subject: activity-induced muscle hyperalgesia
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF mRNA was significantly increased when compared to pain free controls in the ipsilateral L4–L6 DRG (p<0.001*, d=3.39) 24hr after induction of the model, but not at 2hr or 1wk (Fig. 3; Table 5).

relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: Significant increases in BDNF mRNA were observed in cultured DRG treated with IL-1β (p=0.01*, d=1.14), compared to vehicle controls (Fig. 6; Table 10).

relationships.subject: ANA-12
relationships.evidence_quote: In males, but not females, the decrease of MWT caused by the pain model was reduced by either ANA-12 intrathecally (p=0.03*, d=1.16), or TrkB-Fc intrathecally (p=0.009*, d=1.51) 24hr after injection of the BDNF inhibitors.

key_findings: BDNF-TrkB blockade (ANA-12, TrkB-Fc) reduces activity-induced muscle hyperalgesia in male but not female mice, although DRG BDNF rises in both sexes.
IL-1β is sufficient but not necessary to induce DRG BDNF; fatigue metabolites plus IL-1β increase BDNF in cultured DRG neurons.
